definitions.explanation: Physical variation in height, such as hills and valleys in landscape or waves.
Figurative variation or fluctuation, such as emotional changes or life circumstances.

examples.japanese: {起伏|きふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{起伏|きふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: This road has many ups and downs and is tiring.

⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{起伏|きふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んでいる→富む：12343_tomu⟧。
examples.english: Life is full of ups and downs.

examples.japanese: {起伏|きふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やかな→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live calm days without many ups and downs.

notes:
{起伏|きふく} means rises and falls, used both literally for terrain and figuratively for emotions or life events. Combines {起|き} (rise) and {伏|ふく} (fall/lie down).

PHYSICAL USAGE (terrain):
- {起伏|きふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: undulating road
- {起伏|きふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧: terrain rich in elevation changes
- {起伏|きふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: having steep ups and downs

FIGURATIVE USAGE (emotions/events):
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起伏|きふく}: emotional ups and downs
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起伏|きふく}: life's vicissitudes
- {起伏|きふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧: story full of twists
- {起伏|きふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a calm, uneventful life

KEY PATTERN:
The expression {起伏|きふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (rich in ups and downs) is very common and works for both physical and figurative senses.
